title: HEDGE FONDO 2019 – p/b Morgan Stanley and benefitting World Bicycle Relief
description: Support this adventure by becoming a Vermont Overland Patron :backhand index pointing down: https://www.patreon.com/VermontOverland --- 2019 was the 8th edition of the Hedge Fondo. In one weekend, we raised over $53,000 for World Bicycle Relief, and over the past three years, $127,000 which equals 853 individual bikes.  This ride was organized by Vermont Overland.  This film was shot and produced by Ansel Dickey // Vermont Social LLC https://www.vermontsocial.media/  --- https://worldbicyclerelief.org/en/ https://www.vermontoverland.com/ https://www.morganstanley.com/

asr.full_text: Music That's how this community works. It's fantastic. I think that's why all of us are here. We love to ride and we don't mind helping people either. The one thing I would say about World Bicycle Relief is the first time I gave 147 bucks, which is really easy to do. I imagined what I was doing was helping somebody who didn't have that benefit, which we all have automatically. Everyone got a Schwinn when they were this high like I did. And I thought it would help them do things that were hard to do, which were easy for us, get to school, etc. And it made me feel good. When we got to Africa, everything I imagined was exactly what I saw, but it felt way better because I think it's in person and you see the impact, of course. The Thank you.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a filmed cycling event and community fundraiser benefiting World Bicycle Relief. The discussion concerns donations to help people access bicycles and education, without promises of investment returns, required financial participation, or credential submission. The patron request supports Vermont Overland's adventure, but no deceptive conditions or financial misrepresentation are described.
